title: Mixed Event — To You, My Caring Companion

meta.Outline: Honami notices that Kanade has been more focused than ever on composing lately. When Emu gives her tickets to a bridal fair, Honami decides to invite Kanade in the hope of her employer taking a break.

rows.Line: Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, the bathtub's all clean.
I hope she enjoys the new bath salts I got for her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've also finished doing the laundry, so I need to get started on cooking her meals next... Lunch too. But what should I make...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We'll start getting warmer weather soon, so she may get tired more easily... Something nutritious and filled with energy might be good, even if it ends up slightly on the heavy side.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see, what was left in the refrigerator...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(That's odd...
The meals I made look mostly untouched.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Were they not to her liking...?
But she seemed to really enjoy this meat and potato stew when I made it before.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh, what if she's not feeling well?
No, she didn't seem sick when I saw her just now...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She's not responding. Maybe she didn't hear me...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It is common for her to not hear someone knocking when she's focused on composing a song...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Still, I'm a little worried...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I know I'm not supposed to do this, but I'll get right back to work after checking that she's okay...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Ms. Yoisaki.
I'm letting myself in...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness... She didn't collapse or anything.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(But this is so strange...
In this state, it's almost as if...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She's reverting back to how things were before...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I'm sorry for letting myself into your room.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You didn't respond after I knocked, which made me a little worried...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you knocked? I'm sorry for not noticing. I was a little too focused on...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, look at the time.
It's almost noon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I was just thinking about making lunch.
But, um... Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When I went to see what was left in the refrigerator just now, most of the food I made was still there. That made me wonder if you weren't feeling well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, no, I'm okay...
I've just been focusing on composing so much lately that eating hasn't been on my mind...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I know how much effort you always put into your cooking.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's okay, really...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...
Is there anything in particular you'd like to have for lunch today?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sure you're hungry, so I'll make anything that you request.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... Actually...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm okay for now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've almost reached a good stopping point for my new song, so I want to keep working on it a little bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll have whatever you make for me later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If that's what Ms. Yoisaki wishes to do, I should just let her...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If this goes on, she might collapse again like when we met for the first time...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A-Actually...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A-Are you sure you don't want to take a break and have some food...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It may not be my place to say this, but I'm worried that you're going to fall ill again and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm really sorry...
I didn't mean to go so far.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, you're right...
All this work would be for naught if I were to collapse again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll have lunch when it's ready. It always tastes better that way anyway.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This meat's a little sour, but it has a nice, refreshing taste to it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad you like it.
I flavored it using plums.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They say plums can help increase your appetite, so my hope is that your stomach will have no problem handling it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I didn't know that...
Thank you for being so considerate.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I just...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, am I not being too much of a bother? I feel like I've been prodding about your health too much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, if anything, I appreciate the way you always look out for me like this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You do? Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Would it be alright if I asked you something else?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, of course. What is it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, did something happen recently...?
Lately, including today, it seems like you've been more focused on your composing than usual.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't say much right now, but a friend of mine is... She's in a bit of a tough situation at the moment...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A tough situation?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. She's had a lot on her mind for quite a while now, and I've been trying to help by composing songs for her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But things took a turn for the worse recently...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which is why I'm trying to compose a song that can save her as quickly as possible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see.
All for this friend of yours...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It really is wonderful how you're willing to do so much for others, Ms. Yoisaki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I do hope you don't push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sure this friend of yours would also worry if you were to strain yourself for her sake.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki.
I promise to be careful.
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad Ms. Yoisaki agreed to have a proper lunch yesterday, but I hope she makes sure to eat again today...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I know...
Next time, I can try making something that she can eat while she works.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Let's see... Is there a good recipe for...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, these sandwiches include a nice helping of protein and vegetables. She could eat them while working if I cut them into bite-size pieces...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What else is there...?)
Hoonaamii!!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh?! Oh, Emu, good morning.
The day's just started, and you're already full of energy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Today's another super sunny day, so I feel like a big old bear in the forest♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
There's something I wanted to give you, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you have something for me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? A ticket...?
For the “Phoenix Bridal Fair”...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! It's a convention that my dad's company planned out!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They're gonna have lots of pretty wedding dresses on display in this big hall with tons of different booths.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And uhh... Oh, right!
They're even having a fashion show featuring different dresses and a workshop where you can make your own bouquets!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I thought you'd really love it since you know how to make all these cute things, Honami! You even said the other day that you like making your own clothes!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, thank you so much! It sounds like so much fun! But are you sure about giving this to me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! My brother said that since they had some tickets for invited guests left over, I can give this to somebody who'd be interested in the event!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope you have lots and lots of fun, Honami☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I happily accept.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Awesome!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, also! Each ticket includes admission for three people, so you should invite your friends too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?! Then, I'll see who else can go. Thank you so much, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, there's the bell! See you later, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (A bridal fair... It sounds like a lot of fun. But who should I invite...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki really likes this kind of thing, so I'm sure she'll want to go... Oh, but she said she's going out shopping with her family this weekend.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Ichika and Shiho...
Both said they have work...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which leaves...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm not sure Ms. Yoisaki would be interested in this sort of event...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But it could give her a chance to take a break. She's been working herself particularly hard lately...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm probably going to sound like a bother...)
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm still undecided about the bridal fair...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I do want to give Ms. Yoisaki an opportunity to take a break, so I think I'll ask her about it the next time I go over to her house...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hey there, Hona!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Rin? What brings you here at this time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I was just flipping through the fashion magazine you brought over, and was so amazed by it that I thought I should thank you!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I had a lot of fun because the clothes in it were really different from the ones in the magazines Sakki brings over☆ So, thanks!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful. I'm glad you enjoyed it so much.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I did! Particularly the pages that featured all those wedding dresses! They were so cute and frilly and sparkly! It's my new dream to wear one♪>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. This month's issue was a bridal feature. The photos of the chapel they had were so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, totally! The dresses and the chapel were so sparkly that it felt like a fairy tale!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A fairy tale... Yes, I see what you mean.
They're the kinds of dresses princesses wear, and a part of me dreams of someday putting one on.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I know, right?! I totally wanna experience that!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, also. Weddings involve vowing to the person you love that you'll be with them forever, right?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. You pledge to be by their side through the good and the bad, and to put your heart into doing what you can for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <To put your heart into it...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That makes it sound like such an amazingly beautiful celebration...!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, Rin, would you like to see what it's like...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A friend of mine gave me this ticket for a convention called the “Phoenix Bridal Fair”.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's supposed to include a dress exhibit, a fashion show and an assortment of different booths.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Really? That sounds like fun!
I wanna go! I'm absolutely going!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, we can see what's there together.
Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Some others may also be coming, in which case you'd unfortunately need to stay hidden for most of the time. Would that be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<No problem!
Wait, are you not going with Ichi and the others?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, they'll be busy that day, so I'm thinking about inviting someone else instead.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, okay! Who?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, her name's Ms. Yoisaki...
I work part-time as a housekeeper and have been going over to her house periodically.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
She's a year older than me and...
She's a very nice person who always works incredibly hard for the sake of others.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <For the sake of others? She sounds wonderful!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She really is. However, she sometimes pushes herself a little too hard, which worries me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I thought this kind of event would serve as a nice break for her...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But she doesn't seem like she'd be interested in bridal fairs, so I'd rather not force her to go...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hmm... I get what you're saying, but I say you should invite her!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You care about this person and want them to be happy, right, Hona? I think that's a really wonderful feeling to have!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Also, don't you have to actually ask her to know if she's interested?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <See? So, you should totally invite her!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, and... If she seems unsure, you can always try giving her an extra nudge!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, isn't that going a little too far...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Well, it would be a problem if they're really against going or something... But sometimes it's better to spur someone on if they're undecided!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <When KAITO or anyone else has something on their mind, I sometimes ask them to hang out and get a change of pace. They usually say they can't make an immediate decision...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But if I'm really persistent, they tend to be glad that they agreed to hang out in the end♪>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
So, I think it's okay to throw your weight around sometimes!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. You may be right...
Thank you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll try asking her about this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Awesome! Good luck, Hona!>
A few days later
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you again for coming today, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll be returning to my room, but please feel free to ask if you need anything from me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. Um... Actually, if possible, there's something I'd like to discuss with you before you go.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, a friend of mine recently gave me a ticket to a convention called the “Phoenix Bridal Fair”...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's a wedding convention that includes a dress exhibit, accessory shops and booths featuring all sorts of bridal goods.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you like to go see it together...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're inviting me...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes...! I wasn't sure if you'd be interested in anything like this...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I was hoping that it could serve as something of a break.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see... Thank you for being so kind and thoughtful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, I was just worried about your health and...!
Well, um, if you're interested...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know. I appreciate you inviting me to this, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, and... If she seems unsure, you can always try giving her an extra nudge!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <When KAITO or anyone else has something on their mind, I sometimes ask them to hang out and get a change of pace. They usually say they can't make an immediate decision...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But if I'm really persistent, they tend to be glad that they agreed to hang out in the end♪>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I, um... I think you'll really enjoy it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Remember when I bought those hydrangeas the other day? You liked them so much that you placed them in your room...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, they were very pretty... Those helped brighten up the house quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The fair's also supposed to feature bouquets made from a wide variety of flowers. There may be some that you like, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not only that... Oh, right! We'll be able to see the inside of a wedding hall! Or... Maybe that doesn't sound very interesting...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: B-But... There's going to be lots of other booths and beautiful accessories and such, so I'm sure it'll be enjoyable just looking around at everything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry. I know I sound really pushy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I... I really do think you'll enjoy it, so we should go together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. If you're willing to say that, Ms. Mochizuki, then I'll go...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're right that it's important for me to take breaks. Also, if they have beautiful flowers like the ones you brought over, I'd like to see them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much! I'm so glad...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, does this Sunday work for you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I don't have any plans, so that should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay! Hehe. This is so exciting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, also. This ticket includes admission for up to three people. If you know anyone else who'd like to go, please feel free to invite them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, there is one person who really likes wedding dresses and such, so I'll try asking them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, please do!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's have as much fun as we can this Sunday.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Normally, there isn't much that I can do for Ms. Yoisaki...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But since she's agreed to join me, I want to make sure she really enjoys herself during this fair.)
The day of the fair
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's almost time for the others to arrive.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I didn't want to be late, and ended up coming a little too early...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Anyway, Ms. Yoisaki and her friend should be...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is.
Thank you for waiting, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's okay.
I just arrived not long ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, is the person you invited already here...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm not sure.
I received a message saying that they're almost here...
Oh, there they are! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Kanade! And this is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Honami Mochizuki, right?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I've mentioned you in conversation to everyone a few times already.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ena has too!
I've heard all about how nice a person you are!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, really...?
I feel a little embarrassed now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! But it's really nice to finally meet you after hearing everyone's stories!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I still haven't introduced myself.
I'm Mizuki Akiyama. I'm in the same music group as Kanade and mainly work as the video editor.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I've also heard your name in passing. It's nice to meet you, and I hope we have fun today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, same!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, also... Thanks for letting me tag along today! I've actually had my eye on this fair for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, a friend gave me this ticket...
Also, I'm glad that you decided to join us since it's always fun to go to these things as a group.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Akiyama...?
Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nothing's wrong!
I was just thinking that you really are a super nice person, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...? R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yes, really!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade, I hope you know how lucky you are to be in the care of such a nice girl.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh...? I, um...
I'm sorry. I do appreciate everything you do, but that might not have come across properly...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, don't say that! I know that you do...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You do?
Then, I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, looks like the bus is here.
Let's hop on!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. This fair's going to be so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it is!
Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa...! So this is a bridal fair!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, there's so many people...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And it's not just couples here.
I'm also seeing a lot of families and groups of friends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It looks like a fun event for all ages.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It certainly does.
Now, where should we begin?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Based on this map, the dress exhibit is straight ahead... To the left is all the accessory shops...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, hey! They even have a wedding hall that you can check out! I'd love to see that!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's so much to do...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and every booth also seems to have quite a lot to offer. It may be difficult to see everything in one day...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. You two have until this evening, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, since I'm also scheduled to work today. I plan to head over to Ms. Yoisaki's house this evening after spending the day here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, instead of trying to see everything in the time we have, we should probably prioritize the things we really wanna check out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, where do you two wanna go?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll leave this up to you two since I haven't really read up on this fair.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There are a couple places I'd like to go, but the map says they're pretty far from here... So, Akiyama, why don't we start with what you'd like to see?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?! Thanks!
Then, mind if we check out the dress exhibit first?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: On top of the dresses made by famous designers, they have some that were made by amateurs who did well in their contest. I really wanna see those!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, wedding dresses...
I've never seen one up close before, so that could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, shall we?
Booth Area - Dress Exhibit

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I don't believe it! This is so awesome!
Look at all these dresses on display...! And they're all absolutely gorgeous!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they are...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's hard not to be overwhelmed by how glamorous they are when you're this close.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. I get what you mean!
I mean, check out the skirt on this one!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The skirt?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's called a princess cut.
These are the kinds of dresses with super fluffy skirts that you see a lot in fairy tales! And the bow on the back of this one is so cute!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's so big.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right?! Oh, this one's a pantsuit dress! Talk about trendy! And the lace on the back's so detailed!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it even has slits!
I really like that. It gives it more of a mature feel.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Akiyama seems to be enjoying this very much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mizuki likes cute clothing a lot. Just looking at that excitement makes me glad I was able to invite an extra friend.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Sorry, you two...!
I sort of don't know what to do with myself...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I understand how you feel since I also occasionally make my own clothes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You do?! So do I!
We could totally be sewing buddies!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I have a feeling that you two would get along really well. On the other hand, I don't really understand the appeal of dresses...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, Kanade, don't say that!
I really want you to see how amazing these wedding dresses are too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! It'd involve me talking a lot, but what if I commentate as we walk around? That might make things more fun!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, sure...
That might really help.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Awesome! Then, let's start with the skirt on this mermaid dress! It's called that because...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They had so many dresses just in that one exhibit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, and I learned so much.
It was fun having you explain each one, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really? That's great to hear!
Well, there's a bunch of other stuff left to check out, so wanna head over to our next stop?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
These must be the accessory shops...
They have tiaras, bracelets, necklaces...
And they're all so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you can even try them on.
Kanade, let's see how this tiara looks on you!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, me...? Sure, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
It looks so pretty on you, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's right! You don't dress up enough, Kanade! So, since we're here, try on this necklace! And this bracelet!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, but...
Oh, they're so heavy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Don't worry! They look amazing on you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You'd probably look like a real princess if you were to put one of those dresses on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That workshop was so much fun!
And we got to make these matching bracelets!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you both for helping me with the tricky parts. Mine wouldn't have turned out this well if you hadn't.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Honami deserves most of the credit.
I saw you had nimble fingers, but you also did a really great job of explaining what to do. You were like everyone's favorite kindergarten teacher.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
R-Really...?
That might be because I actually taught kindergarten for a day. Anyway, I'm glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm? What's going on over there?
A lot of people seem to be gathering...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... That seems to be the fashion show for wedding dresses and tuxedos. How about we go take a quick look since we're here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This is way too much fun!
And we haven't even covered half of it! Talk about an amazing fair!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, every booth had such interesting things to see.
Where should we go ne—

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Is she starting to get tired...?
We have been walking nonstop since this morning. Also, Ms. Yoisaki isn't particularly fond of crowds...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. The corner for the bouquet exhibit's supposed to be around here somewhere. I was hoping to take a look at it, so would it be okay if we went there next?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ooh, I wanna check it out too!
How about you, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... Sure...
Bouquet Exhibit

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow, these are so pretty...!
They've got so many different types too. Round, oval and even wreaths!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, not only that...
It smells very nice here somehow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It must be all the fresh-cut flowers.
The roses, the lilies of the valley... So many gentle fragrances all mixing together. It's very soothing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, definitely! And there aren't that many people here, probably since this exhibit's way in the back. We can relax here for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds nice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We saw so much. It's almost noon, so let's find a place where we can sit and have lunch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do you know if there's anywhere good around here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, there's a nice-looking cafe right by this event center. Rumor has it that the food's very good.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nice! Honami with the good intel!
Alright, let's go check it out!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And after we've had a filling lunch, let's get right back to it and make the most of our afternoon!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, two toast sets and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: One curry set, please!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Understood.
We'll have those right out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's good we didn't have to wait at all to get a table. And this place looks so nice!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Their lunch menu also looked very good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it did.
Oh, I need to go use the restroom for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Do you know where it is?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think so. I saw a sign for it pointing towards the back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, Honami, now it's just the two of us. Let's take this opportunity to get to know each other a little better.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When we were walking around the fair, Akiyama, it was clear how much you like fashion and cute accessories.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm also interested in fashion...
I even make scrunchies and other accessories, so it'd be nice if we could talk more about that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?! I'd love that too!
It's so hard to find people to talk to about sewing and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, but... I think there's something we need to get out of the way first.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
My name!
This has been on my mind since this morning, but it's totally okay to just call me Mizuki! We're the same age, right? Also, I've already been calling you by your first name.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? O-Oh, of course...
Then, if it's alright with you...Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm... You still sound a bit tense...
But it's a start and a step in the right direction!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, Honami, I'm really glad we're getting to hang out like this♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-You are?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I've been wanting to meet you for a little while now after hearing so much about you from Kanade, Mafuyu and Ena!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In particular, I wanna hear more about your job. I'm amazed by every story I hear.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You help clean and cook for Kanade at her house, right? But she doesn't really care about anything other than composing music. She hardly ever cleans her room and even skips meals whenever she starts focusing on a song...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, yes... You could say that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But she's able to work on her music because you're there for her, Honami. So, I've been wondering what you're like all this time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see... But I've also noticed that Ms. Yoisaki's been changing recently. Compared to before, she eats more regularly, and even goes out more often.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And most of all, she seems much more relaxed and has been smiling more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think you and your group are having a positive effect on her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I dunno if we have anything to do with that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's obvious that you pay close attention to her, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's clear based on what you just said that you really care about her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, really...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is there some reason behind that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When I first began doing this job, Ms. Yoisaki's grandmother made a request.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She asked me to please do my best to look after her granddaughter even though she can be a handful at times.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, it's not just that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think I'm worried about Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When I first met her, she looked like she was in so much pain... She was always saying how she had to keep composing and create a song that could save people...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't know what led to her thinking that way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But after spending so much time with her, it's become clear to me that she's a wonderful person...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, I may not be able to do much for her...
But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
She always gives her all for the sake of others...
I decided that I want to do what I can for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know this all just sounds overbearing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I don't think that at all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm really glad you told me that...
I now know for a fact that you genuinely care about Kanade's well-being.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I feel a lot better knowing that she has someone like you by her side.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I'm just...
Again, I can only help out so much...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't say that! You invited Kanade out today because you wanted her to take a break, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You did that because you care, and I think it's gonna benefit Kanade a lot.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've also been kinda worried considering what's happened to us recently...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
Are you talking about your friend?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, do you already know about that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Only vaguely...
I was told that your friend is in trouble and Kanade is trying to compose a song for her sake.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, so... She's in a bit of a tough spot and is really being pushed to her limit right now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Plus, Kanade promised to save her.
Out of all of us, she's definitely the most worried about all this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: To save her...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So, Ms. Yoisaki really is doing everything she can to save her friend...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which explains why I thought she was acting the way she did when I first met her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, Honami, it's pretty huge knowing that you're there to check up on Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: At the very least, she's not gonna collapse on us since she's finally eating better♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know I'm in no position to be saying this, but please keep looking after her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Kanade, welcome back!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We were actually just talking about you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? About me...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I was asking about what you're like at home and what you eat on a regular basis!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, um... I-I'm sorry...
I know I haven't been eating much recently, but I promise to from now on.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's perfectly fine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Right now, Ms. Yoisaki feels that she needs to focus on helping her friend...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is there anything I can do to help her...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm not in her group like Mizuki and the others, so I can't exactly help them with what they do...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I mean, all I can do at the moment is cook, clean and do the laundry for her...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But she agreed to join me for this fair today, so I'd like to help her enjoy it as much as possible.)
Several dozen minutes later
Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Phew, I'm stuffed!
Alright, where to next?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm... We still haven't seen...
*Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honamiii!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. What are the odds of us running into each other here?!
Thank you so wonderhoy for coming!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, you're with Akiyama and Yoisaki!
So you all came together!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You remember us?
Long time no see, Emu! Not since New Year's, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... You're Mafuyu's junior from what I remember...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Otori, that's it.
I didn't realize you'd be here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm here to help my dad because his company's hosting this fair!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
It's been a wonderful fair so far, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
I'm actually done for the day...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I wanna learn as much as I can about how events like these are run! So, I've been exploring to see what everything's like!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, that's pretty cool!
Wait a second... Your dad's company...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Emu, does that mean you're an Otori as in the Otori Group?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu's the one who gave me this ticket.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, that means we were able to attend because of you. Thank you, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, I know! Emu, since you're here, wanna check out the fair together?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! There's still lots we haven't seen, and we'd love to hear your recommendations!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. Would you mind, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Leave it to me!
I'll be more than happy to show you all the best spots!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Perfect!
Also, there's no need to be formal. We're all friends here!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, that would make things much easier...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?! Then...
Let's go, Mizuki, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, have you three already seen the dress exhibit? They have all these sparkly dresses that are so fun to see!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we saw! They were so pretty that I totally didn't know what to do with myself!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We also looked at the accessories, attended a workshop... Oh, and saw the fashion show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That fashion show was super fun!
I wanna go see it again if we have time♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That leaves... Oh, have you tried on any wedding dresses yet?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What? You can try them on...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, they booked the chapel next door for this event, and you can try on all the dresses you want over there!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Trying on a wedding dress...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That sounds amazing! We gotta go check it out! How does that sound, you two?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, that sounds good.
I'm guessing you're going to enjoy it quite a lot, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd like to go as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, I'll lead the way!
We're gonna try on the cutest dresses we can find☆
Wedding Dress Fitting Area

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh wow! Look at all the wedding dresses...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa! Check out that ball gown!
It looks so fluffy!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No sleeves either! It's simple and really pretty! Oh, this mini skirt's also super cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We can seriously choose from any of these dresses?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! Pick whichever you like!
The staff here will answer any questions you have☆

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Cool! Then, where to start...
Maybe something standard, like an A-line...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, those are over that way!
I'll show you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Those two certainly seem to be enjoying themselves. Which would you like to try on, Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm not sure...
I don't even know where to begin, so I'm okay with just seeing what's here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But wouldn't you like to try one on since we're here? It might be a good change of pace to put on something that you don't normally wear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Why don't we try picking something out together? If you tell me your preferences, we may be able to find one you like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. Let's find one together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was initially under the impression that wedding dresses all had to be white. But the dress exhibit showed me how they come in a variety of colors, and I see the same thing here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: White is the old standard, but there's actually nothing wrong with choosing another color. What do you like, Ms. Yoisaki...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Well, I'm not set on any particular one, but something simple and subdued might be nice if I'm going to be wearing it. I'd feel pretty embarrassed if I ended up standing out by wearing something too vivid...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, one of these may work...
This one has a bit of light gray mixed in.
Yes, I think this would look really good on you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Or... Oh, how about this one?
The lace pattern on it is so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, I think I'll try this one.
Thank you for helping me choose, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad we were able to find something you like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too. Oh, but... Ms. Mochizuki, you haven't picked a dress yet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't mind me. It shouldn't take me too long to pick one.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you apologizing?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel like I've been giving you things to worry about this entire day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not only did you go out of your way to invite me to this event, you just helped me pick out a dress to wear...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even when we were going around the booth area, you noticed that I was tired and suggested that we go somewhere with less people.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry.
I must've seemed too overbearing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, please, don't say that.
If anything, I'm glad you're so worried about me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's just... I feel like I'm making you work even though you're technically off right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know this isn't normal.
So, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I...
I like doing this is all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, please don't mind me.
As long as you have fun today, I'll be happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Then, I will...
Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I just wanted Ms. Yoisaki to enjoy herself, but that ended up having the opposite effect...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This is so much more difficult than I realized...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey!
Have you two picked out your dresses yet?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, Kanade, is that what you're gonna wear?! It's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Ms. Mochizuki helped me choose it.
Otori, Mizuki, have you already picked yours out?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆ I just found the one I wanna wear!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm still kinda torn...
Can I ask you all for your opinions?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sure. Oh, but... Ms. Mochizuki still needs a dress.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Then, Honami, you should probably go find one for yourself!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'll go with her!
Kanade, you help Mizuki pick a dress☆

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, but I don't know if my opinion will help...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't worry! Just say whatever comes to mind for me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami, they have lots and lots of pretty dresses here, so I'll try to show you as many of them as I can!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I really appreciate it, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... Honami! Honami!
How about this one?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh! What a pretty pink, like the color of cherry blossoms... It's so lovely!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it! I thought it'd look really great on you! Also, just gimme a second to bring over some of the dresses I saw in that other section!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Is something wrong, Honami?
You're all bunched up like a scrunchie...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: L-Like a scrunchie...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I mean... You look like you're thinking a whole lot and your heart's being squeezed really tight!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: At least, that's the expression you had on your face just now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa! It's a real wedding hall!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<You can be in a mock wedding here, right?!
I wish I could be in one...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I may actually be able to make a veil for you... We can try having one in SEKAI the next time I'm there with the others.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really?! Woohoo☆>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
That was so much fun. Thanks for showing me around, Hona!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh, that reminds me...
How's that person you invited doing? Did she enjoy herself today?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, she enjoyed herself very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And it's all because you said I should invite her, Rin. Thank you very much for making that suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really?! That's great to hear!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But you deserve more credit for doing all the hard work, Hona! I'm so glad she's all smiles now!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I'll make sure to bring the souvenirs you picked out over to SEKAI later. Please look forward to them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Awesome☆
Hehe. I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Then, I think I'm gonna head back.
Thanks so much for today, Hona☆>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad you enjoyed everything so much, Rin. I'll see you later in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay, see you! Bye bye!>

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... The others should be...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki! There you are.
Wait, where are Mizuki and Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Ms. Mochizuki.
They're browsing through souvenirs right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm a bit tired, so I decided to rest here in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Then, let's wait for them together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had a lot of fun today because of you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so happy to hear you say that...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure if I should at first, but I'm really glad I invited her out today.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. Someone must've just sent me a message. But who...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Is everything okay...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, um, yes...
It's nothing serious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The friend I told you about before just contacted me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've been talking to her during the day lately, but she apparently won't be available tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did something happen...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, no trouble or anything.
Just student council business.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, everything's fine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, really. Everything's fine...
I was just a little surprised to receive a message from her is all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
I'm sorry for looking so worried.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, would you like something warm to drink? It is starting to get a little chilly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'll go buy us something.
What would you like to have?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Hm... Then, tea might be nice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, tea and water.
That should do it...
<Hona.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Sorry, I'm still here...
I sorta didn't want to go back so soon.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Also, is that the person you were talking about? Ms. Yoisaki, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, that's her.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is everything okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, everything's fine.
I was just thinking...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When I saw Ms. Yoisaki smile, I felt like I'd managed to help her feel better...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I actually accomplished very little.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hona...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's nothing to be surprised about, of course. I knew that cheering her up a little wouldn't actually solve what's going on with her and her friends...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I knew that, but my mind keeps wandering back towards it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But I still think you did a really great thing today, Hona...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I mean, I'd be beyond happy if I saw someone trying to do so much for me!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I know! Hona, remember those vows you told me about earlier?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The thing about being with the person you care about for better or for worse?!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hearing that almost brought me to tears! I mean, it's such a beautiful thought... Promising to be with someone through thick and thin no matter what!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So, even when Ms. Yoisaki thinks things are tough or tires herself out from trying so hard... I'm sure she feels better knowing that you're there for her!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you think so...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! Which is why what you did for her today's gotta mean a lot to her...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<And everything you usually do is really amazing too!
There's no two ways about it!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Am I wrong? You're always thinking about what's best for Ms. Yoisaki, right?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You make all this delicious food for her, clean her house, do her laundry... You put your whole heart into it...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's why I think you're a humongous source of support for her!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I think I see what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Rin.
I feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Great!
I feel better too after seeing you smile☆>
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much for today, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not only did you give me a ticket, you were nice enough to show us around the fair. We had such a wonderfully fun time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
I also had a lot of fun hanging out with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's get together again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We could go window-shopping for cute clothes... Oh, we could even try sewing together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Mizuki and I can both be your teachers.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that does sound like fun! I wanna give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... Compared to the rest of you, my dexterity's probably not very good...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But since you've invited me, I'd like to give it a try as well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, see you later, Honami, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: See you again, Emu, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Things seem so much quieter without them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Ms. Mochizuki, that reminds me. Your plan was to head straight for my house, right?
If you're tired, I don't mind if you go home and rest for today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that won't be necessary.
My plan hasn't changed since this morning.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we?
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I apologize for making you help me buy and carry over the groceries.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, this is the least I could do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm sorry as well.
I was hoping to split the load with you, but I couldn't even carry half as much as you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's perfectly fine!
I've been doing arm workouts for band, so I feel like I can carry quite a lot now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Now, I'll get started on dinner.
Please feel free to retreat to your room, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... I'd like to help you with that. I'm sure you're tired after everything that happened today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wouldn't be able to relax knowing that you were working.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's make dinner together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Just chop down the lines of the onion first, then perpendicular to mince them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh wow.
But some pieces are sticking to my knife. Does that mean I didn't cut them properly...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. You did just fine.
So, would you mind doing one more for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay, I'll try...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Am I wrong? You're always thinking about what's best for Ms. Yoisaki, right?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You make all this delicious food for her, clean her house, do her laundry... You put your whole heart into it...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's why I think you're a humongous source of support for her!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I appreciate what Rin said...
But is that really true...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Yes, what we did today seemed to make Ms. Yoisaki feel a little better...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But does making dinner with her like this really help...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Ms. Mochizuki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, um...! Not at all!
Oh, I'll get started on the salad. The cabbage is in the refrigerator, yes...? Eep!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A-Are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I hit my foot on this chair...
B-But it's nothing at all...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, we just got back, so you must be tired. Are you sure you don't want to take a break?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's actually something I'd like to give you. Please wait here a moment.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... O-Of course...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Here it is.
I picked out a present for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, I asked Mizuki and Otori for some advice because I wasn't sure if I'd be able to choose something you'd like...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, so...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope you'll accept it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...
But why...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was able to have a lot of fun today because of you, Ms. Mochizuki, so I wanted to thank you somehow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's something I felt spending time with you and the others today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
How do I put it...?
Having someone next to me with my best interests in mind is such a nice thing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which is why I felt that I needed to properly show my appreciation for you, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: When I'm at home composing songs by myself, there are times I get so caught up in it that I lose sight of everything else...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But you always reach out when that's happening to me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not only that, what would normally seem mundane, such as the food you cook and the smell of freshly laundered clothes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's all very comforting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm convinced now that I can keep composing songs because you're there to support me, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, thank you for everything you do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Ms. Mochizuki? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, not at all...
I-I'm just so happy that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
Is it alright if I open this now?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it's...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What a beautiful bouquet... With many different types of flowers too... These white ones look like dahlias, these are bluestars, and I'm seeing a few roses as well...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I saw that there was a bouquet-making workshop, so I decided to make one there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They had so many types of flowers available too. I tried putting this together while asking Mizuki and Emu for some advice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wh-What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Rin was right...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'd convinced myself that I really wasn't doing all that much to help...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I was completely wrong.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(What I do does matter.
Staying by Ms. Yoisaki's side helps her in so many different ways.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I promise to keep doing my best...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Cooking, cleaning and doing the laundry may seem simple... But I'd like to keep supporting you like this moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll keep having me over...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Of course. I wouldn't have it any other way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know I can be a handful at times...
But I'm really glad to have you here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The bouquet Ms. Yoisaki made is so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Just looking at it...
I can sense her kindness.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I know that the pain and sadness Ms. Yoisaki feels won't go away so easily...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I hope her dream of saving others comes true someday...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I hope she succeeds in saving the person she's trying to help right now...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(And eventually...
I hope she can start thinking about her own happiness.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (No, not eventually. Soon. As soon as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which is why I have to keep supporting her.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for this present.
I'm beyond overjoyed!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness. I'm glad you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well then, shall we resume cooking...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Ms. Mochizuki. Would you like to have dinner here tonight? I'm sure you've worked up quite an appetite...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It'd seem like a shame if only I got to have this food considering how we made most of it together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
In that case, I'd love to stay...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's continue where we left off... I have to get better at mincing these onions...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
You did just fine a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can start making the salad once you've done that. It's very simple to prepare, so you should be able to pick it up quickly.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? Then, Ms. Mochizuki, if you don't mind showing me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course!
